method_note.counting_changed: On 2026-10-17 counting changed from the $TICKER cashtag to the BARE ticker (TICKER without $), because the free x tools now strip '$' from queries ('$ was removed from query'). Bare counts include plain-text mentions (and company-name mentions where the ticker is the name), so they are NOT directly comparable with counts before 2026-10-17. Ranking uses mentions_clean_est = bare count x the share of sampled posts that are real stock mentions ($cashtag or ticker + stock context).
method_note.auto_switch_back: every bare run starts with a probe call '$NVDA -is:retweet'; if the tool no longer reports that the $ was removed, the script switches back to cashtag queries

not_measurable.rule: bare ticker is a common word (wordfreq zipf >= 3.0 in English or >= 4.0 in de/fr/es/it/pt/nl), 1-2 letters, or curated slang/acronym; these cannot be counted honestly without the $ and are left out of the sweep and the ranking
not_measurable.context_rule: ambiguous core names counted only together with a finance-context word: TICKER (stock OR stocks OR shares OR earnings OR calls OR puts OR premarket OR nasdaq OR nyse OR bullish OR bearish OR "price target" OR dividend OR investors OR portfolio OR rally OR selloff); label context-required

source.metric: sum of the last 5 hourly buckets (= meta.total_tweet_count over the window)

counted_not_ranked.note: individual counts of tickers that are not measurable (config/ambiguous_tickers.txt) are dropped and never published

clean_share_rule: clean_share_est = (clean + 10 x prior) / (posts + 10) over the ticker's own recency samples of the last 72h; prior = pooled own-sample clean share (0.505); mentions_clean_est = mentions x clean_share_est; sample_clean_share is from co-mentions (list dumps) and only informational
ranking_rule: rank_score = round(rank_score_raw x clean_share_est), ties by rank_score_raw. rank_score_raw = 5h count, except that a burst hour (an hour > 6 x max(29h hourly median, 3) whose next hour fell below a third of it) is capped at that limit; only differs from mentions for burst-flagged entries; ties by mentions

group_sweep.query_pattern: (T1 OR T2 OR ...) -is:retweet -whatsapp -telegram -tg -"stock analyst" -"hot stocks" -"discussion group" -"investment advisor" -"join for free" -"exclusive group" -"Ms. Victoria" -"follow him" -"dm me" -"dm for" -"private channel" -"copy trade" -challenge -signals -mexc -"my go to" -vote -leaderboard -coinmarketcap -"listing id" -airdrop -memecoin -memecoins -solana -pumpswap -dexscreener -gmgn -"pump.fun" -mcap -marketcap -mc -ca -"my call" -cabal -token -crypto -bnb
group_sweep.note: A group count is an exact count of posts mentioning ANY ticker of the group (a post with several of them counts once), with the spam filter applied. It is an upper bound for every member, so a quiet group means all its tickers are quiet.

adaptive_splits.rule: each run, the unsplit node with the most posts in the last 24h (>= 40) is split into 4 contiguous parts; if the node was counted in this run, 3 parts are counted and the 4th is parent minus the 3 (per hour, >= 0; an under-estimate when posts mention tickers of several parts), else all 4 are counted; nodes with <= 3 tickers are leaves whose members get exact daily counts; the tree persists in data/splits.json (pruned after 30h without a count, cold splits collapsed)

risers_rule: rank_score >= 20 and max(momentum_5h_vs_prev_day, momentum_last_hour_vs_prev_9h) >= 3.0, where the last-hour ratio only counts if the last hour is also >= 2x the same hour yesterday; momentum = (now+1)/(baseline+1)

spam_handling.filter: every X query (group sweep, every individual count, every sample) carries the spam suffix
spam_handling.post_rules: sampled posts are dropped for discovery if the author is in config/spam_accounts.txt, the text is a template (same text from >= 3 authors), a ticker dump (> 8 cashtags, or >= 4 cashtags with < 8 real words), or contains a filter term
spam_handling.clean_gate: a discovered or carryover ticker is only ranked if a sample of this run (or a passed check <= 24h old) shows clean posts from >= 3 distinct authors and, with >= 5 sampled posts, a clean share >= 30%; others are listed in held_back with their count
spam_handling.sample_clean_share: sample_clean_share = clean / all sampled posts mentioning the ticker (relevancy samples, small n); informational, the rank stays the exact filtered count; core entries below 30% get the label low-clean-share

held_back.reason: no sample evidence of clean posts from 3+ authors

word_collision_guard.label: suspected-word-collision
word_collision_guard.rule: bare mode: a ticker is held back when its bare 5h count is > 8x the median of its $cashtag 5h counts before 2026-10-17 (only for bare counts >= 50), or when it has no $cashtag history and the bare count is > 300 (exempt: core, megacap and context tickers, and tickers with a median $cashtag 5h count >= 100; they are scaled by their own-sample clean share as usual); it is queued for an own recency sample in the next run and ranked (with the cleaned estimate, label collision-check-passed) once >= 10 own sampled posts in 72h show >= 30% real mentions

freshness: every ranked ticker was counted individually in THIS run (last_measured = time of its count; all over the same UTC window). Tickers measured in earlier runs today are in data/today.json, not here.
note: Ranks the tickers counted individually in this run: the megacaps (every run) plus this run's exact daily counts (split leaves, sample discoveries, hot re-reads, core due today), all over the same UTC window. The whole stock universe is screened at group level every run and hot groups are split adaptively, but a ticker is only ranked if it was counted individually. The daily view of everything seen today is data/today.json.
